copy.curiosityHook: Trapped behind fortress walls while devastation sweeps the land outside, the mercenaries must face the looming consequences of their bold abduction.
copy.description: Cheated by a noble lord, a band of medieval mercenaries enacts revenge by kidnapping his son's fiancée, ultimately holing up inside a castle as plague and warfare devastate the surrounding countryside.
copy.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful, and gritty adventure with an engaged pace and an atmosphere of impending ruin.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Paul Verhoeven, this medieval drama balances gritty historical action with high-stakes tension, delivering an unrelenting clash of vengeance and survival.

allowedMaterial: mercenary band seeking revenge on a noble lord
kidnapping of the noble lord's son's fiancée
excludedMaterial: fate of the mercenaries or the captive fiancée
